body: What if you set the `vicmd_symbol` to something?

For me this appears to affect all symbols. For example I have 
```
[git_status] 
untracked = "U"
modified = "M"
[git_branch]
suffix = " " 
symbol = ""
```

But the prompt still uses `[!?]` and     ``



FWIW, my config is at `~/.config/starship.toml`

Can you upload the log message here?

```bash
RUST_LOG=starship=trace ./starship prompt > log.txt 2>&1
```
